set.body:
Phase A (P0 correctness hotfix, additive wire change only).

Problem:
core/Observation.scala:6 flattens base states and flags into one SlurmState enum and omits BOOT_FAIL, DEADLINE, SUSPENDED, RESIZING, REVOKED, SIGNALING, STAGE_OUT, STOPPED.

cli/SlurmParsers.scala:502 actively discards the flag suffix before matching:

    raw.trim.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
       .takeWhile(character => character != '+' && !character.isWhitespace) match

so CANCELLED+ becomes Cancelled with no record that the job was still completing. :208-211 additionally takes only .headOption of the array-valued job_state, so ["RUNNING","POWER_UP_NODE"] is indistinguishable from ["RUNNING"] at the typed layer. This contradicts docs/compatibility.md:95-97, which promises unknown states and flags are preserved.

Failure mode: BOOT_FAIL parses to SlurmState.Unknown(raw), which yields InterruptionClass.Unknown, terminalState = false, and stateCause = None. A terminal job is invisible to every classifier and the remote awaiter polls it for its full 24-hour default.

THREE independent hand-written classifiers exist, all omitting BOOT_FAIL and DEADLINE (the review named only two):
- core/Observation.scala:33  InterruptionClass.classify
- core/FailureDiagnosis.scala:447  stateCause
- managed/ObservationCoordinator.scala:139  terminalState

Fix (additive; the structural base-token/flags redesign is P8.D3):
- Add the missing base states and stop discarding the flag suffix.
- Consume the full job_state array.
- Derive ONE Terminality and route all three classifiers through it. No fourth hand-written match.

Acceptance:
- Test: a BOOT_FAIL accounting row is terminal and the awaiter exits instead of polling. RED against parent.
- Test: CANCELLED+ retains its flag; ["RUNNING","POWER_UP_NODE"] retains the tail.
set.title: P8.A2: Complete the Slurm state model additively and derive one Terminality
